providers.title: Ollama (local)

workflow_support.notes: Default installed workflow path via REVIEWSENSEI_PROVIDER_MODE=local and local model variables.

limitations: Requires a reachable local Ollama runner on loopback.
No bearer credential is used for the default local-private profile.

providers.title: Ollama Cloud

workflow_support.notes: Installed workflows opt in with REVIEWSENSEI_PROVIDER_MODE=cloud and repository OLLAMA_API_KEY secret.

limitations: Requires a provisioned Ollama Cloud account and OLLAMA_API_KEY.
Cloud egress is explicit opt-in; local runs cannot silently fail over to Ollama Cloud.

providers.title: OpenAI-compatible (Python boundary)

workflow_support.notes: Installed GitHub workflows do not pass --profile; fast-triage is an explicit CLI/evaluate path only.

limitations: Named profiles are immutable presets; custom endpoints require unprofiled openai-compatible use.
Not enabled by the reusable workflow; requires OPENAI_API_KEY and --profile fast-triage or equivalent settings.
The npx launcher forwards argv to the Python CLI; reaching openai-compatible still requires explicit --profile fast-triage (or unprofiled flags) plus OPENAI_API_KEY.

providers.title: OpenRouter

workflow_support.notes: Installed workflows opt in with REVIEWSENSEI_PROVIDER_MODE=openrouter and repository OPENROUTER_API_KEY secret. The supported label applies to this hosted workflow path with allowlisted models only.

limitations: Hosted OpenRouter accepts only the published allowlist in provider_config.HOSTED_OPENROUTER_DEFAULTS; the default_model matches DEFAULT_OPENROUTER_MODEL (deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash).
CLI profiles openrouter-sonnet and openrouter-gpt remain unqualified and require --allow-unqualified-profile for live review; tests/test_cli.py covers the opt-in and fail-closed paths.
The npx launcher forwards argv to the Python CLI; reaching OpenRouter still requires explicit --provider openrouter (or --profile) plus OPENROUTER_API_KEY.
Hosted workflows reject allow_unqualified_profile=true; use the CLI for unqualified profile runs.
